title: Data Scientist | AI Engineer | Business Development
summary: Hi, and welcome to my personal resume where I've gathered my experience, education, and projects. As a natural problem solver fascinated by how data drives business decisions, I bring an unusual combination of experiences. I've spent 10 years building and developing companies across different industries. For the last three years, I pursued a bachelor's in Applied Data Science to expand my technical expertise, developing skills in Python, machine learning, and data analytics. This journey from hands-on business development to data science gives me the perspective to translate insights into measurable business results, and I'm eager to help organizations unlock the potential in their data. I developed this interactive resume website not only to display my expertise, but also to showcase my technical skills in a practical, hands-on way. If you have any questions or want to discuss potential opportunities, do not hesitate to reach out.
